title: Per-resource safety vector
description: effects.md §2. Allowed values form a total order per resource kind. A class-D or class-M step targeting a resource below the manifest's minimum — or at none — is refused; there is NO manifest opt-in to mutate at none.

service_state.description: Rollback restores only the unit's desired active/inactive state. Consequences of a start/stop/restart — a webhook fired, a database migrated on boot — are NOT rolled back and must appear in the operation's added_effects as M/E.

dataSafety.description: dedicated_snapshot means a dedicated, separately-mounted subvolume/dataset with its own snapshot schedule and an exercised restore procedure.
